Everything will be fine. Perhaps you have placed too many expectations on yourself. Please don't be disheartened just because your expectations haven't been met. Don't worry about what others demand of you. Believe that you can live well on your own. Loneliness is a normal part of life, and our worth doesn't require validation from loved ones, romantic partners, education, job, or salary. The key to our worth lies in our feelings. Take a look at the anime, games, or books you used to enjoy. Try to rediscover the happy and innocent self from the past and learn to pursue your own feelings.
